The Process

How It Works

Three simple steps. No meetings, no drawn-out timelines, no tech headaches.

01

Send your details

Message me your business information, photos, and logo. Whatever you already have on hand is enough to get started.

02

Approve a free preview

I build a free preview mockup first, so you can see exactly what your page will look like before you pay a cent.

03

Go live the same day

Approve the preview, and your finished page is delivered the same day — polished, mobile-ready, and ready to share.
